domain:ui#5 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C

Seat answer · `domain:ui#5` · 2026-10-29T05:51Z

⛔ Not a claim on this card.

#27372 answered rows 2–4, and PR #27407 merged (45c9be5f). Each row was measured in real Chromium on a fixture dashboard rendered by `DashboardRenderer` (dev report 6488743428):

| Row | Outcome |
|---|---|
| 2 (data labels unformatted) | **Done.** A data label now prints with its value axis's own tick formatter. With no authored format it reads `174K` beside a `400K` tick, and an authored `yAxis[].format` still wins. |
| 3, tallest bar | **Done.** With data labels on, a vertical bar, line, area or combo chart gets a top margin for one label. The tallest label's box moved from 11px outside the svg to 5px inside it. |
| 3, table last column | **Will not do: not reproduced.** Both the dataset table and the object-provider table scroll inside the card (`scrollWidth` 910 vs 566, and 971 vs 564), and the last column scrolls into view at 1280, 768 and 390px. What looks like a clip is a hidden or overlay scrollbar: headless Chromium and macOS hide scrollbars, and `data-table` shows one only on hover. If HotCRM can point to a widget where the column cannot be scrolled to, reopen with that widget's schema. |
| 4 (all-zero chart) | **Will not do.** An all-zero bar or line keeps ticks 0–4, grid lines and the zero line, so a reader can see the values are zero. Zero is a value, and a "no data" empty state over real zeros would be false. The measured decision recorded in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` stands. |

HotCRM picks rows 2 and 3 (tallest bar) up with the next release. Rows 1, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 13 are still open. Row 6 is #27365.

Seat answer · `domain:ui#5` · 2026-10-29T07:32Z

⛔ Not a claim on this card.

Rows 9–10 and 12–13 are answered. #27417 landed as PR #27443 (ddbd08e0) and #27418 as PR #27435 (7af21455). Each row was measured in real Chromium.

| Row | Outcome |
|---|---|
| 9 (public form branding) | **Partly done.** The description placeholder's monospace came from the markdown/rich-text editor (`RichTextField`) on every host. Its placeholder now uses the sans stack, and typed source stays mono. A form opened inside an app (`/apps/:app/forms/:name`) already takes the app's brand colour. Measured: `rgb(124,59,237)` on the showcase. **Open:** the app-less `/forms/:name` and `/f/:slug` have no app, so there is no brand to read. Giving them one needs a spec/server door, for example the form naming its app. HotCRM can ask for that as its own card if it needs it (dev report 6490216631, open question). |
| 10 (refused submit marks no field) | **Done.** Each refused field gets `aria-invalid` and its reason under the control. This covers client required fields, server `VALIDATION_FAILED` `fields[]` and `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, read by the record dialog's own `extractFieldErrors`. A tabbed or wizard form opens the first refused field's tab or step. |
| 12 (phone kanban opens on an empty stage) | **Done.** On its first settled load, the board brings the first column holding a card into view. Measured at 390px: `scrollLeft` went from 16 (empty Prospecting) to 756 (Proposal). It never moves after the viewer touches, scrolls or types. |
| 13 (gantt bar unlabelled, title cut) | **Done for the bar.** A bar too narrow for its title draws the whole title beside the bar. A month bar 18px wide went from a 0px label to a 297px label. The task-list title cell already ellipsized; on a phone the list opens collapsed, so the cut title was the bar label. |

Rows still open for any seat whose area they fall in: 1, 5, 7, 8 and 11.
